title: Sentences on Virtue and Judgment
english: The Lord will be vindicated, but in the houses of the arrogant, curses will be multiplied. He who violates His law dishonors God, but he who keeps it glorifies Him who made it. If you zeal for Christ, you will become blessed; but if you die His death, your soul will die, and evil will not separate from its flesh, but your departure will be like the departure of a star, and your resurrection will shine like the sun. Woe to the lawless in the day of death, and the unrighteous will perish in an evil time. Just as a raven is driven away from its carrion, so an impure soul is driven from its own body. Angels guide the souls of the righteous, but demons will seize the souls of the wicked. Wherever evil enters, there also ignorance enters, but the hearts of the holy will be filled with knowledge. A merciful monk will be wealthy, but nourishing the poor he will inherit treasures. Poverty with knowledge is better than wealth with ignorance. A crown of the head is the world, but the knowledge of God is the crown of the heart. To acquire knowledge and not silver, and wisdom more than wealth, is much. The righteous will inherit the Lord (Ps 102:24), and the holy will be fed by Him. He who pities the poor quells anger, and he who nourishes them will be filled with good things. Wisdom will rest in a gentle heart, and a practical soul will be a throne of apatheia. Builders of evil things will receive an evil reward, but to builders of good things an excellent reward will be given. He who sets a trap will be caught in it, and he who hides it will be taken by it (Prov 1:11-19). A worldly man is better than an angry and irascible monk. Passion scatters knowledge, but patience gathers it. Just as a strong south wind is in the seas, so is passion in the heart of a man. He who prays continually escapes temptations, but for the one who is negligent, thoughts disturb the heart. Let not wine gladden you, and let not meat delight you, so that you do not consume the flesh of your body, and shameful thoughts will not cease from you. Do not say:
